title: List screen
description: A title, a search field and a filter over a FlatList of records with status tags, pull to refresh, a details sheet and an empty state

quality.rows: Each row a Card direction="row" with radius="none" border="transparent" background="transparent", paddingX="20" paddingY="12": Avatar or icon, a Column flex={1} of a truncated label-strong-m and a body-default-s subline, the value and a size="s" Tag at the end
quality.chrome: Title, search and filter above the FlatList, not inside it, with a Line under them
quality.search: Input type="search" size="s" with a search Icon as prefix; the filter a SegmentedControl of two to four options
quality.empty: ListEmptyComponent: an icon, one line of text and the action that fills or resets the list
